package.name: sqlite_vendor
package.description: Builds the SQLite3 C library (version 3.46.1) from the upstream amalgamation, patched for VxWorks, so rosbag2_storage_sqlite3 can find_package(SQLite3) and link SQLite::SQLite3. VxWorks has no system libsqlite3-dev and the raspberrypi4b SDK ships no SQLite3 in its sysroot; 3.46.1 matches Ubuntu 26.04 (resolute) libsqlite3-0. The VxWorks source patches are delivered via the layer (patches/sqlite_vendor/usr_src) and applied on top of the fetched source.
